serviceName: Send reports from your own domain
description: Authenticates the customer's domain with Fleetbunker's email provider (Brevo) so client reports can be sent from reports@ their own domain: one verification TXT record and two DKIM CNAME records. It does not touch SPF, DMARC or MX.
variableDescription: brevo_code is the verification hash (the part after brevo-code:, the same for every domain of one customer account) and dkim_zone is the per-domain label in the DKIM CNAME targets (b1.<dkim_zone>.dkim.brevo.com and b2.<dkim_zone>.dkim.brevo.com, normally the domain with dots as dashes). Both are generated by the email provider when the customer adds the domain in Fleetbunker.
